functional.resolvedFailure: Original calendar viewport test read height before ResizeObserver had updated. Changed the same geometry assertion to expect.poll; passed three consecutive repeats. No assertion threshold relaxed.
functional.additionalRetest: Native personal history passed after matching original initial expansion order.
functional.releaseGate: Full GitHub CI and Pages browser suite must pass for the final commit before publishing.

visual.method: Original and native production pages, isolated contexts, Chrome on macOS, Asia/Shanghai, fixed clock 2026-10-07T04:00:00Z, Math.random=0.2; animations/transitions/caret disabled before page layout. Raw RGBA comparison, no masked regions or tolerance silently applied.
notes: Most residual differences are 1–8 edge pixels or channel delta 1. Raw nonzero results are retained below and are not labeled pixel-identical.
The 1024px personal-history header difference was fixed by matching the original home-before-history expansion order; all four tablet history captures are zero.
A transient desktop calendar navigation transport error was rerun successfully with zero difference.

Tablet team-task-new was attempted and found hidden in both original/native collapsed sidebars; it is excluded from measured pairs rather than counted passed. Underlying task dialogs and operations are covered by functional tests.

perceptualComparison.antialiasing: Playwright default exclusion of detected antialiased edge pixels
perceptualComparison.notes: All 31 raw-nonzero screenshot pairs were also checked with the same standard comparator. At stricter threshold 0.01, 258/260 pairs pass; the other two each differ by one low-color-delta pixel.
